## Summary
Encodes and decodes the WebRTC playout delay RTP header extension. The package owns extension identifiers, delay bounds, error sentinels, and conversion between millisecond delay values and the packed 12-bit wire format.

## Responsibilities
- Define the playout delay RTP header extension URI and bounds.
- Clamp requested playout delay values to the representable maximum.
- Marshal min and max delay values into the three-byte RTP header extension payload.
- Unmarshal min and max delay values from packed RTP header extension bytes.
